hypothesis.claim: The post-event 8 ms max adjacent-sample derivatives in the seven selected Bass physical-PANEL and Funky1+2 source fixtures are dominated by oscillator/filter and bypass-sine audio entering the modeled IG00151 VCA, rather than an instantaneous key-gate reset or VCA-only envelope/pedestal transient.
hypothesis.primary_prediction: If both M41-model audio carrier paths into the VCA are disconnected for the entire replay but the oscillator, filter, IG00159 envelope, IG00151 level node, envelope-driven offset/feedthrough, coupling, output and MIDI events still clock normally, absolute maxJump in the original event window will be <=10 percent of the unchanged full-path event absolute maxJump in at least six of seven fixtures.
hypothesis.falsifier: Audio-carrier-disabled ratio >0.10 for at least two of seven fixtures, a non-finite trace, broken pre-event PCM pairing, or a gate-induced change of an exposed charge/history state at zero elapsed time (after independent idle wake) refutes the corresponding prediction; report without modifying production or score gates.
secondary_predictions: Filtered-path-only and sine-only controls will partition the audio-carrier effect; no CP3 dominance percentage is assumed before measurement.
Funky original note-off omission will retain large natural post-event waveform derivative in full-path PCM; the relative note-off effect must be measured independently of this derivative.
The original source full-path scores remain FAIL where previously red; no derived control is allowed to replace the original gate.
